Antarrashtriy nyayalay (ICJ) ne myanmar ko rohingya narsanhar ke lie jimmedar thahraya hai. halanki, is phaisle ke bavjud rohingyaon ki surakshit aur sammanajnak ghar vapsi ki rah aasan nahin hai. myanmar men loktantr, shanti aur rajnitik sthirta ke bina unki vapsi sanbhav nahin dikhti.
Thank you for watching our video!
